data.name: Verve
data.detailed_description:
Verve is a liminal space horror game with an advanced, Source Engine-like movement system including but not limited to bhopping and surfing, allowing for a high-skill ceiling and infinite replayability. Verve includes a Backrooms-inspired singleplayer campaign, as well as a robust 128-tick multiplayer system with game modes like Hide and Seek and Nextbot Escape.

Play the Backrooms-inspired singleplayer campaign where you play as RT-6, a member of Percept Lab's professional rescue team. You are tasked to find a group of research scientists who sent out a call for help followed by radio silence. Explore the Verve, evade and hide from entities, make your way to the scientists, and uncover the dark truth behind Percept Labs. After being sent into the Verve dimension, you start to realize and uncover the dark truth about Percept Lab's practices, this isn't going to be a walk in the park.

Verve has a robust, 128-tick multiplayer architecture with player movement prediction and validation. Verve includes a dedicated server tool that allows for hosting servers, as well as player hosted servers, both of which you can join through Steam. Multiplayer includes game modes like Hide and Seek and Nextbot Escape.

Verve has a sophisticated movement system supporting consistent bhopping, air strafing, surfing, ladder strafing, trimping, and more. The movement system in Verve has been designed to imitate Counter-Strike: Source movement that you would find on bhop/surf servers with a few stylistic distinctions, notably slightly expanded upon water movement, different player height, and a crouch height closer to Half-Life 2.

data.short_description: Verve is a liminal space horror game with advanced movement (bhop, surf, etc.) and 128-tick multiplayer. Find a group of scientists lost deep inside the Verve and rescue them in the Backrooms-inspired singleplayer campaign or jump into multiplayer game modes like Hide and Seek and Nextbot Escape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2000 Series/Intel 7th Gen Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1600 Series/AMD Radeon RX 5000 Series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5000 Series/Intel 13th Gen Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3000 Series/AMD Radeon RX 6000 Series
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
